notes.title: Small OST update
notes.content:
Hi guys,
We've pushed out a small update to the OST today: Track 2, Disc1 of the soundtrack has been renamed and moved to Disc2 Track26- dear friend (short ver.).  Its original spot, Disc1, Track02 is now the full-length version of the same song. ReplayGain tags were also updated across the OST to reflect the change.

The story behind this was the raw WAV version of the file had never been obtained from the music house during production, only a downsampled mp3 version for reference use had been availble

The game uses the short version in-game so no one really noticed that the incorrect version was in the WAV archives that were then used to build the OST release.

Much later on, a few users brought the issue to our attention, and we first had to confirm that a full version existed, then we had to go track down the original data. It took a while but we found it, hence this update.

notes.title: Narcissu 1+2 updated to new engine.
notes.content:
Narcissu 1 and 2 have been updated and ported to the same engine as the rest of the anthology. . This should help provide a more consistent experience with the rest of the anthology.


Other changes in this update:
* Translation for 1st and 2nd edited and updated to be consistent with the rest of the Anthology. 
* Presentation also standardized to voiced mode to be consistent with the rest of the Anthology
* Launcher includes a button for the soundtrack, which opens the soundtrack folder for easy access
* Japanese/English versions of 1st+2nd are accessed via steam's language properties, consistent w/ the rest of the anthology


One tradeoff we had to make in this process was to standardize on a single translator for the whole series (Agilis). Users that prefer the other translations can always play them in the free Narcissu 1st and 2nd release, which remains 100% unchanged. 

http://store.steampowered.com/app/264380/Narcissu_1st__2nd/

notes.title: Extra BGM track added to the soundtrack
notes.content:
A sharp-eared fan contacted us saying that we had accidentaly left out one piece of music used in the game, so we did some digging and updated everyone's OST DLC with the additional track (#25 on Disc2). You guys should update your playlists if you haven't yet! 

Enjoy!


We're also super curious to hear what everyone's favorite tracks are, feel free to let us know!

notes.title: Narcissu Zero now available for purchase!
notes.content:
The next chapter of the anthology is now available for purchase in the store! Season Pass holders and Kickstarter backers already have had their installations updated with the new chapter.

This leaves the final chapter, "Sumire" to be released later this year.

There have also been major updates to the chapter launcher and file structure to prepare for future updates and releases. Users should experience no visible changes, but very rarely, users who changed their language settings may experience broken save files from the restructuring. Please contact support if that happens to you.

notes.content:
Narcissu Zero is ready for launch this week! Yay!

As a small treat for our early supporters, we're giving Kickstarter backers and season pass holders a couple of days early access to the final version of the chapter while we sort out final details related to the store page and launch.

The full store release is scheduled to happen later this week, so keep an eye out!
